HUMAN RESOURCES DIVISION\nREQUEST FOR EM.[NULL2]: M.G.L. c. 111C, § 1 defines EMS first response vehicle as “any aircraft, boat, motor vehicle or any other means of transportation, whether privately or publicly owned, which is intended and is maintained and operated for the rapid response of EMS personnel, equipment and supplies to emergencies by an EMS first response service or by an ambulance service and is not utilized for patient transport.”
HUMAN RESOURCES DIVISION\nREQUEST FOR EM.6. Detail the reasons for requesting EMT: The department is requesting selective certification due to a sustained shortage of certified EMTs at the required levels. Recent retirements and increased call volume have strained coverage, resulting in unfilled vacancies and reliance on overtime and mutual aid. Recruitment has been challenged by regional competition and the need for specialized training for ALS care. Selective certification will allow targeted hiring to restore minimum staffing levels, maintain ALS-capable response on all shifts, and improve response reliability while the department implements longer-term recruitment and retention strategies.
